count.purpose: Live seconds or reps in the player, in sand; the only size allowed above the 6rem display cap, so it reads from the floor.

display.purpose: Session title on home and the finish title. Ceiling for all titles.

headline.purpose: Feed item, library and sheet titles.

title.purpose: Exercise name in the player and rest screen.

statement.purpose: Stacked progress sentences on the progress item.

lede.purpose: One-line focus under a title, soft paper.

label.purpose: Meta lines, level names, tab, rail and filter labels; sits below or beside, never above a title.

shadows.name: glyph-halo
shadows.purpose: CSS filter on rail glyphs and labels over photographs; legibility only, never on surfaces.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Full-screen overlay settling text into single-frame photo screens.

shadows.name: scrim-stacked
shadows.purpose: Short bottom band on stacked start/end feed items so the end frame stays undimmed.

shadows.name: backdrop-blur
shadows.purpose: Blurred copy of the photo filling the screen behind the 3:2 frame.

shadows.name: frame-mask
shadows.purpose: Mask fade on the 3:2 photo frame; stacked frames use 8%/92%.

motion.name: snap
motion.purpose: Single-axis vertical slide between player steps and for full-screen layers (from 18% offset, 40% opacity). Removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: tile-zoom
motion.purpose: Library tile photo scale to 1.04 on hover.

motion.name: photo-swap
motion.purpose: Start/end frame alternation, stepped with no crossfade. Removed under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one paper action per screen: Commencer, Suivant, Juste bien.

components.name: Story Segments

components.css: .ds-feed { position: relative; width: 300px; height: 520px; overflow: hidden; background: #121316; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding-bottom: 24px; } .ds-feed-bg { position: absolute; inset: -40px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #3f4550, #2a2f39 60%, #1e2026); filter: blur(26px) brightness(0.42) saturate(0.8); } .ds-feed-frame { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5a6472, #8b857e); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, #000 14%, #000 72%, transparent 100%); mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, #000 14%, #000 72%, transparent 100%); } .ds-feed-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(10,10,10,0.7) 0%, rgba(10,10,10,0) 14%), linear-gradient(to top, rgba(10,10,10,0.97) 0%, rgba(10,10,10,0.9) 30%, rgba(10,10,10,0.45) 42%, rgba(10,10,10,0) 54%); } .ds-feed-text { position: relative; z-index: 3; margin-top: -44px; padding: 0 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; color: #f2f2f0; } .ds-feed-text h2 { margin: 0; font-family: Antonio, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 0.9; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-feed-caps { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 450; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(242,242,240,0.74); } .ds-feed-target { margin: 0; font-family: Antonio, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(242,242,240,0.74); }

narrative.overview:
Each moment of a session owns the whole screen: one exercise, one number, one action, and the next moment is a single vertical flick away. The world is a full-bleed vertical media feed on a near-black ground. A public-domain photo of the move sits full width in its own 3:2 frame, its top and bottom edges dissolving into a blurred, darkened copy of itself that fills the rest of the screen; the text block rises out of that faded lower edge under a bottom scrim. Story-style segments at the top say where you are, a right-hand rail of glyphs carries the secondary controls, and one white button carries the primary action.

The system is dark-only by choice and replaced an earlier light/dark orange "bento" UI of cards, pills and KPI tiles; that dashboard vocabulary is the confirmed rejection. White is the interface colour. Sand is the single accent and it means "where you are and what is counting". Display type is a tall condensed face set in caps, large enough to read from a mat on the floor; everything else is the quiet system UI stack. Density is low: one idea per screen, generous dark space, no containers.

The phone frame is a single column capped at 480px and centred on wider screens; there is no separate desktop layout.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed vertical feed, one complete state per screen, snap between states.
Photo frame (3:2) with a mask fade over a blurred copy of the same photo; text overlaps the faded edge under a scrim.
Near-black ground, white interface, one sand accent for progress, current state and the live count.
Condensed Antonio caps for titles and numbers; system UI for body and spaced-caps labels.
No cards, no borders around content, no decorative shadows; hairline rules only inside lists.

rules.name: The Sand Means Now Rule
rules.body: Sand marks progress, the current position and the number being counted. It never fills a button, a background or decoration; if a sand element doesn't answer "where am I / how much is left", it should be paper.

rules.name: The Photo Is the Colour Rule
rules.body: The interface stays monochrome so the photograph supplies all hue. Don't add a second accent to compete with it.

rules.name: The Condensed Caps Rule
rules.body: Every title and every big number is Antonio, uppercase, line-height 0.82–0.95. Body and labels never use Antonio.

rules.name: The Floor Count Rule
rules.body: The live count is the one element allowed past the 6rem display ceiling. Nothing else competes with it on the player screen.

rules.name: The Label Sits Below Rule
rules.body: Spaced-caps labels describe what is above them (level under exercise name, meta under title) or sit beside the story segments as a status line. They are never stacked as a kicker above a title.

rules.name: The Scrim Is the Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadows on surfaces. Legibility over photos is solved with the scrim, the mask fade, the glyph halo or the 92% void tab bar.

dos: Do give each state the whole screen and move between states with a vertical snap (scroll-snap on home, 260ms single-axis slide in the player).
Do show photos in their 3:2 frame with the top/bottom mask fade over a blurred, darkened copy, and let the text block overlap the faded edge under the scrim.
Do set titles and numbers in Antonio caps at line-height 0.82–0.95, and cap titles at 6rem; only the live count exceeds it.
Do keep sand for progress, current position and the live count.
Do put secondary controls on the right glyph rail and keep one paper primary button per screen at 56px.
Do keep stacked start/end frames undimmed; the scrim on exercise items is a short bottom band only.
donts: Don't build cards, pills, KPI tiles or bento grids; this world replaced exactly that.
Don't add a light theme or a second accent colour.
Don't use box-shadows; the scrim, mask fade and rail glyph halo are the whole depth vocabulary.
Don't place a spaced-caps kicker or eyebrow above a title.
Don't use Antonio for body text or labels, or the system stack for titles.
Don't use sand on buttons, backgrounds or decorative marks.
